::: {#exr-autograd-descent}

#### Finding the cutoff by gradient descent

Run 100 steps of [gradient descent](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/gradient-descent.html#the-algorithm) on $\hR$,
starting from $\param = 0$ with learning rate $\learnrate = 4$,
with each step's derivative from `torch.autograd.grad`.
Where does $\param$ end up,
compared with the lowest point on the grid of cutoffs in the [machine learning review](ml-review.qmd#sol-smooth-loss)?

:::
